requirement: A site brief names no CMS or template: one brief of a research feeds demos on any CMS and template, the build freezes its choice, one live build per (brief, choice), and collected data still wins over sample content

oracle.invariant: S1: the brief is valid and holds no cms, cmsSource, resolvedAt or template; the build's view carries them and is valid. S2: the choice carries CMS, template, workflow and the acceptance lines naming them; the stored brief is untouched; the key differs only on what makes two demos different. S3: the same research answers the same brief; the Settings change reaches only the next build. S4: refused BUILD_EXISTS before any charge. S5: acceptance says collected prices, dishes, reviews and ratings are shown as held and sample content only fills what was not collected.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
